# Substrate_Level_Computation

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
Performing computational tasks directly within the physical interconnect substrate (e.g., nanoparticle network) rather than in separate processing units. Aligns with TCC's goal of embedding computation into network topology, reducing data movement and latency.
